name: Helen Ashworth
about: Twenty years in national news, the last eight running a newsdesk.
Moved to Lisbon and now advises newsrooms on how they work.
Has seen what attention metrics did to the craft.
why: PrompTugal needs someone from the news industry to run the company as CEO, and very technical journalists.
Agents do the research and the production; editors decide what is true and worth telling.
note: Helen, deck 7 is the one I wrote with someone like you in mind. Then deck 2, the argument about where news went wrong. Tell me what you would change first.
